name: Shiin
source:
The Tokyo metropolitan area's H City. In this suburban city, a strange rumor has been spreading recently. Those who possess the «mark» will die. The «mark» is unexpectedly engraved onto the body, as if it was a chewed up birthmark, and is said to result in an unknown death.

As a matter of fact, a strange incident occurred where someone met a suspicious death. This incident has become an urban legend, and has propagated various speculation such as it being the result of a ghost encounter somewhere or unknowingly coming into contact with a curse.

Having lost your memory, [url=/c64690]you[/url] stand before a western-style house said to protect those who possess the «mark». As if drawn to something, when the doors to the house open, you're greeted by a beautiful [url=/c64691]doll[/url] who is the lord of the mansion.

«Welcome to Kujou Mansion.»

The doll continued to speak.

«You will die if you stay like this.»

«But that doesn't mean that there isn't a way to be saved.»

The countdown to «death» had already begun…

[Edited from [url=http://gematsu.com/2017/01/death-mark-first-details-screenshots]Gematsu - Japanese Video Game News[/url]]
translation:
东京大都会圈的H市。
最近，这座郊区城市开始流传奇怪传闻：拥有“印记”的人会死。“印记”会像被咬过的胎记一样，莫名刻在身体上，据说会导致未知死亡。

事实上，某地发生了一起离奇死亡事件。事件成为都市传说，引发各种猜测：有人认为死者遇见了幽灵，也有人认为死者在不知情的情况下接触了诅咒。

失去记忆的[url=/c64690]你[/url]站在据说保护“印记”持有者的西式宅邸前。仿佛受到某种东西吸引，宅邸大门打开，你看见迎接自己的美丽[url=/c64691]人偶[/url]——她是宅邸主人。

“欢迎来到九条宅邸。”

人偶继续说道。

“你这样下去会死。”

“但这不代表没有获救的方法。”

通往“死亡”的倒计时，已经开始……

[据[url=http://gematsu.com/2017/01/death-mark-first-details-screenshots]Gematsu-日本电子游戏新闻[/url]编辑]
